newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy pays $18.7 mln for Alaska rights.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy pays $18.7 mln for Alaska rights.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said Thursday it has paid more than $18.7 million to acquire working interests from Stewart Petroleum Co and others in Alaska's West McArthur River field.
The company said it acquired a total working interest in the petroleum field of 97.75 percent, with a corresponding 72.25 percent net revenue interest.

Forcenergy said it will assume operations for the West McArthur River field, which has proven reserves of more than 2.6 million barrels of oil. The field's current daily production is about 1,100 barrels.
The company said it also acquired six exploratory leases as part of the deal.
